title: Mohd Hai Mohd Suno Faryaad Mohd
body:
MOHD HAI MOHD SUNO FARYAAD MOHD
JALLAD AASTEEN CHADHATA HUA CHALA
KHANJAR KO UNGLIYO PE FIRAATA HUA CHALA
MAJME KO RAASTE SE HATAATA HUA CHALA
ARKAANE DEENE HAQ KO HILAATA HUA CHALA
AB KYA BATAAOO PAAO RAKHA KIS MAKAM PAR
PHAT-TA HAI SINA AALE SHAHE TASHNAKAM PAR
ROOHE RASOOL KEHTI HAI JALLAD REHEM KAR
YA SINA MERA SINA HAI YE SAR HAI MERA SAR
YE DIL HAI MERA DIL YE JIGAR HAI MERA JIGAR
YE MERA NOORE AIN HAI YE HAI MERA PISAR
TU BAITHA HAI HUSAIN DILAWAR KE SINE PAR
YE LAUT-TA THA TERE PAYAMBAR KE SINE PAR
ZEHRA PUKAARI ARSHE ILAAHI HILAANONGI
AY SHIMR TUJHPE AAH GI BIJLI GIRAAOONGI
USKA NA MAARE GA TO DUA DETI JAAOONGI
MEHSHAR ME HUR SE PEHLE TUJHE BAKHSHWAAOONGI
ISS NAUHE PAR BHI ARSH KO USSNE HILAA DIYA
KHANJAR KO BOSAGAAHE NABI SE MILA DIYA
CHILLAAEE FIZZA HAAE KHUDA AUR NIKAL PADI
KUBRA PUKAARI WA ABBASA AUR NIKAL PADI
BANO NE SAR SE KHENCHI RIDA AUR NIKAL PADI
ZAINAB PUKARI WA AKBARA AUR NIKAL PADI
PEECHE PUKAARTE HUE BACHCHE BHI AATE THE
